title: Tiger cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M66 34 L63 38 L69 38 Z' fill='#b32a24'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f0913a'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='84' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f0913a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='92' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f0913a'/>

  <ellipse cx='56' cy='93' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffe0a8'/>

  <path d='M58 68 Q64 60 64 54' fill='none' stroke='#f0913a' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='53' r='5' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M32 70 Q26 74 26 78' fill='none' stroke='#f0913a' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='79' r='5' fill='#ffe0a8'/>

  <circle cx='45' cy='46' r='20' fill='#f0913a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='30' r='7' fill='#f0913a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='30' r='7' fill='#f0913a'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3a0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3a0'/>

  <path d='M45 27 L45 33' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 28 Q37 32 38 35' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 28 Q53 32 52 35' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 44 Q31 46 29 50' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 44 Q59 46 61 50' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='55' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffe0a8'/>

  <circle cx='38' cy='45' r='3.4' fill='#2e1a0e'/>

  <circle cx='39.2' cy='43.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53.2' cy='43.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <path d='M42 50 L48 50 L45 53.5 Z' fill='#c85a6a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 53.5 Q45 58 40 58' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a2a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M45 53.5 Q45 58 50 58' fill='none' stroke='#8a4a2a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek stripes -->
  <path d='M27 55 L33 55' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 55 L57 55' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
